args.query: FBI UCR violent crime murder robbery aggravated assault national estimates

args.topic: FBI crime data year over year national violent crime rate change

sql: SELECT offense_name, trend_pct, current_range, last_refresh_date, type FROM crime.cde_trends ORDER BY offense_name
SELECT DISTINCT time_series_start_year FROM crime.bjs_nibrs_estimates ORDER BY time_series_start_year DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DISTINCT "year" FROM crime.cde_offenses ORDER BY "year" DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT "year", offense_code, COUNT(*) AS n_months, SUM(offense_rate) AS annual_rate, AVG(population) AS pop, AVG(population_coverage_pct) AS cov FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='national' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025') AND offense_code IN ('violent-crime','homicide','robbery','aggravated-assault','property-crime') GROUP BY "year", offense_code ORDER BY offense_code, "year"
SELECT DISTINCT offense_code FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='national' ORDER BY offense_code
SELECT DISTINCT state_abbr FROM crime.cde_offenses ORDER BY state_abbr
SELECT DISTINCT offense_code FROM crime.cde_offenses ORDER BY offense_code

SELECT "year", COUNT(DISTINCT state_abbr) AS n_states, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS n_months, AVG(population_coverage_pct) AS avg_cov, MIN(population_coverage_pct) AS min_cov FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE offense_code='violent-crime' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
SELECT month FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE offense_code='violent-crime' AND "year"='2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

SELECT "year", offense_code,
  SUM(offense_rate * population / 100000.0) AS est_count,
  SUM(population)/12.0 AS avg_pop_proxy
FROM crime.cde_offenses
WHERE offense_code IN ('violent-crime','homicide','robbery','aggravated-assault','property-crime')
  AND "year" IN ('2024','2025')
GROUP BY "year", offense_code
ORDER BY offense_code, "year"
SELECT "year", month, SUM(population) AS total_pop FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE offense_code='violent-crime' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY "year", month ORDER BY "year", month
SELECT "year", month, AVG(population_coverage_pct) AS cov FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE offense_code='violent-crime' AND "year" IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY "year", month ORDER BY "year", month
